body_markdown:
Just in case you needed another reason to descend into the[Petersen Automotive Museum](https://www.hagerty.com/media/tags/petersen-automotive-museum/) ’s labyrinthine basement,[the Vault](https://petersen.org/pages/petersen-exhibit/the-vault) has a great new exhibit. *[Jeff Zwart: Life at Zwartspeed](https://petersen.org/pages/petersen-exhibit/jeff-zwart-life-at-zwartspeed)* includes some fantastic Porsches from Zwart’s collection as well as a few artifacts from his long career as an automotive photographer and filmmaker. Even if you’re familiar with his name, there are likely many Zwart product photographs you’d recognize but might not have connected with him. The exhibit features his iconic Porsche and BMW ads that took the car world by storm in the ‘80s and ‘90s—none with his name publicly attached at the time. Such is the life of a commercial photographer.


Zwart grew up as a Porsche fan, learning to drive in his father’s early Porsche 911. His career behind the camera intertwined him with the brand. Of course, his long career also put him in a position to add many Porsches to his collection, several of which he raced. A couple of those racing machines appear in the metal as part of the Petersen’s exhibit.


Zwart drove this 2002 Porsche 911 GT2 in the High Performance class at the 2002 Pikes Peak International Hillclimb. He finished first in class with a time of 12:48.30.


[Brandan Gillogly](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/brandan-gillogly/)


Zwart’s racing career includes an impressive collection of class wins at Pikes Peak; he claimed top honors in Open in 1994, High Performance Showroom Stock in 1995, 1996, and 1998, High Performance Showroom Stock 4WD in 1997, High Performance in 2000 and 2002, Time Attack 2WD in 2010, and Time Attack 1 in 2015. The 2002 Porsche 911 GT2, which he ran in 2002, is no longer part of Zwart’s collection, but the Petersen managed to get hold of it for display.


If you’d like to see this exhibit, be sure to[add Vault entrance to your Petersen ticket](https://petersen.org/pages/tickets) . You can see it now through June 13, 2027. It’s a can’t-miss experience for Porsche fans, racing buffs, advertising nerds, and photography enthusiasts alike.


This Colorado Hill Climb Championship car has earned 19 class wins in the 2WD Rally Division, where it runs on dirt, just like Zwart is used to from the days before Pikes Peak was fully paved.
